description: Check whether a string is a valid UUID (any version; braces, urn:uuid: and missing dashes accepted) or ULID, and report its version, variant and canonical form. For UUID v1, v6, v7 and ULID also returns the embedded creation time. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/uuid-forge/

id.description: The UUID or ULID to inspect.

name: id_inspect
title: Inspect a UUID / ULID
